scope: Both specified first-party IR HTML bodies were captured with durable intent and response receipts before parsing; HTTP 200. Findings are limited to these release bodies and do not claim no other company disclosures exist. No forecast, valuation, quote or ledger action.

sources.facts: CrowdStrike announced the Falcon platform became available in the OpenAI Marketplace; eligible OpenAI enterprise customers may use a portion of existing OpenAI commitments to purchase CrowdStrike. Company presents this as a new purchasing channel / partnership expansion and says it may unlock more Falcon adoption spend. Article also mentions Falcon Guardian protection for Codex agents and GPT-5.6 Cyber. No dollar amount, uptake/customer count, incremental commitment amount, ARR, revenue, backlog, or revised financial/Q3 net-new-ARR guidance reported.
sources.title: CrowdStrike Brings the Falcon Platform to the OpenAI Marketplace

sources.facts: Fal.Con Europe 2026 said sold out, reaching capacity faster than ever; registrations up 60% year over year; more than 3,000 security leaders from over 1,200 organizations across 83 countries expected in Barcelona. Context: prior Las Vegas Fal.Con 2026 drew more than 10,000 cybersecurity leaders. These are event/registration reach measures, not customer wins, contracts, recurring revenue, backlog or product demand conversion; no ARR or revised financial guidance included.
sources.title: Fal.Con Europe Sells Out at Record Pace as CrowdStrike Puts the AI Advantage in Defenders’ Hands
